item.title: [LOW] CVE-2026-15809: A flaw was found in CRI-O. The fix for a previous vulnerability (CVE-2022-4318) ...
item.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. The fix for a previous vulnerability (CVE-2022-4318) was incorrect, allowing it to be bypassed. An attacker capable of setting environment variables on a container can inject a newline character into the HOME environment variable. This issue allows the addition of arbitrary lines into /etc/passwd by use of a specially crafted environment variable.
